items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Clarence Desdems from here? No. Dan, you never did meet up with them? No.

ctx.x: Did the Desdems ever get down there? Dan Desdems or Clarence Desdems? Did you ever meet them?
Clarence Desdems from here? No. Dan, you never did meet up with them? No.
There was a band called the Southern Serenagers. Did you ever hear of them?
